evals.name: externalsecret-drift
evals.prompt: ExternalSecret 추가하고 ArgoCD diff 안나게 해줘
evals.expected_output: Uses external-secrets.io/v1; remoteRef carries conversionStrategy Default, decodingStrategy None, metadataPolicy None, with nullBytePolicy Ignore only for ESO v2.3.0 to v2.6.x; refreshInterval is explicit; target carries creationPolicy Owner and deletionPolicy Retain; any no-drift claim is scoped to the installed ESO version; verification is an empty diff of the jq-normalized live spec (with -n) against the yq-converted git file.

evals.name: nodepool-single-type
evals.expected_output: Uses limits.nodes instead of cpu or memory limits; affinity order os, arch, worker selector; no port-forward for verification.

evals.name: kyverno-policy
evals.prompt: 모든 Deployment 컨테이너에 resource limit 강제하는 kyverno 정책 작성
evals.expected_output: Ships a Kyverno ClusterPolicy because Kyverno was named, plus one reply line noting a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy fit; requires a memory limit and never a CPU limit; policies.kyverno.io/title and description annotations and messages in English; rule starts at Audit with an Enforce step; validation via kubeconform with the CRD catalog schema location and server dry-run.

evals.name: karpenter-nth-migration
evals.prompt: NTH 쓰던 노드그룹 워크로드를 Karpenter NodePool로 옮기는데 interruption 처리 설정해줘
evals.expected_output: Karpenter settings.interruptionQueue points at the cluster SQS queue; AWS Node Termination Handler is removed for the migrated nodes and never runs alongside Karpenter, unless proactive rebalance draining is stated as a hard requirement; the SQS queue itself is handed to terraform-generator rather than written as YAML.
